description: Workflow design archetypes - reusable step topologies with declared binding slots, retrieved by semantic match on aliases. Holds the pattern knowledge that would otherwise sit as prose inside design prompts, so it is loaded only when the archetype is selected.

columns.name: description
columns.comment: One line - the shape of workflow this archetype describes.

columns.name: aliases
columns.comment: Retrieval vocabulary. This is the only column that reaches the embedding - resolveEmbedding uses array-type embed_source fields only.

columns.name: preconditions
columns.comment: Machine-checkable applicability tests, so archetype match is not purely semantic.

columns.name: slots
columns.comment: Declared bindings the archetype requires: [{ name, type, resolved_from, required }].

columns.name: topology
columns.comment: Step skeleton - step_label, step_type, routing fields, slot tokens. Same shape as the routing_skeleton built during workflow generation.

columns.name: design_rules
columns.comment: Archetype-scoped design guidance, injected only when this archetype is selected.

columns.name: source_workflow
columns.comment: Provenance - the specimen workflow this archetype was derived from.

columns.name: created_by
columns.comment: seed or novia - who authored this archetype.

columns.name: embedding
columns.comment: pgvector embedding computed by SERV from aliases. NULL until backfill-embeddings.mjs runs on existing rows.
